notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Hey naysayers!

Just wanted to say a big [i][b]thank you[/b][/i] to everyone who's bought the game so far!

Nancy was developed almost entirely remotely [i](we only had one week with the full team working in one place!)[/i] and during lockdown, so it's been a very difficult road. Seeing people enjoying the game we worked so hard on has been heartwarming, and we're extremely grateful to everyone who's given Nancy a shot!

[b]If you've enjoyed Nancy, please consider leaving a review![/b] We're a niche game, so it's very helpful to have people describe their experiences for anyone browsing Steam. Also, they're fun to read.

From everyone on the team,
[i][b]Thank you![/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/b76abf3cac6c9066017b69b41f46c98a4d491728.png[/img]

notes.title: 2 days left to get Negative Nancy on sale!
notes.notes:
[i]With only two days left to buy [b]Negative Nancy[/b] on sale, we decided to interview some of the characters from the game. We wanted to hear their thoughts on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/82970633874e05f5dd6c3069bee6946315b85c96.png[/img]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]How long have you and Nancy worked together?[/i]

[b]Co-worker:[/b] Nancy? Uhh… probably since around the time my mother and I stopped speaking to each other...

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Did Nancy have something to do with that?[/i]

[b]Co-worker:[/b] No… my mother was just really controlling… she did a lot of damage to my self esteem when I was growing up. I’ve talked about it a lot with my therapist. I want to try and re-establish communication, build bridges… but it has to be on my terms! I’m not going to let my mother bully me any longer… I’ll be the one setting boundaries now.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]What do you think of Nancy’s rise to fame?[/i]

[b]Co-worker:[/b] I don’t think it has anything to do with my mother… she’s never met Nancy. And at this rate she never will… I’m not going to end up like my brother. That’s why I don’t drink.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Any comments on Nancy, specifically?[/i]

[b]Co-worker:[/b] No, like I said… my mother’s never met Nancy.

[i]Only two days left to grab Negative Nancy on sale! Don't miss out![/i]

notes.title: Negative Nancy is available NOW!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=RAd5siQ5GWo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Negative Nancy[/b], our 'choose your [i]no[/i] adventure' game is now available!

The episodes you unlock by playing the game are filled with secrets, side-paths, alternative endings and bizarre situations. Play for a second or third time and you might experience a very different story!

Each episode played on normal speed lasts for roughly 20 to 30 minutes depending on path taken, so you can play it in bite sized pieces or just binge the whole thing.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/ed99a165b22cfdbd480f3e192ab38f95755483e4.png[/img]


We're a small team, and we're thrilled to finally release [b]Negative Nancy[/b] into the world like tearful parents sending a small, disagreeable child to their first day at school.

If you want to talk more about Nancy, or you're just tired of screaming into the void you can join our discord!

https://discord.gg/RQW8SWZ 

[i]Happy Naysaying![/i]

- The team at FEED

notes.title: Nancy Launches Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
[i]With [b]Negative Nancy[/b] coming to Steam tomorrow, we decided to interview some of the characters from the game. We wanted to hear their thoughts on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/e80dd3d33544543d720555b01a982e751bba9c7b.png[/img]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Excuse me, ma’am. Were you just served by Nancy?[/i]

[b]Customer:[/b] What did you say her name was? Nancy?

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Nancy.[/i]

[b]Customer:[/b] Are you her manager?

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]No, I—[/i]

[b]Customer:[/b] That little snake refused to let me return a faulty product just because I bought it from another store! What are you going to do to make this right?

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]I don’t work at—[/i]

[b]Customer:[/b] Well you better start working because you’re going to lose a customer otherwise. I should sue this store for violating my human rights! Again… what are you going to do to fix this?

[b]Interview:[/b] [i]I’m just here to interview—[/i]

[b]Customer:[/b] Useless... I want to speak to your manager!

[i]Negative Nancy will be available on October 14th on PC, Mac and Nintendo Switch. Wishlist today![/i]

notes.title: 3 Days Until Launch!
notes.notes:
[i]With [b]Negative Nancy[/b] coming to Steam in 3 days, we decided to interview some of the characters from the game. We wanted to hear their thoughts on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/5892974edc92d1fd3c8ae6c66c65a40cb24c493d.png[/img]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]As someone who works with Nancy, what do you think of her recent rise to fame?[/i]

[b]Co-worker:[/b] Honestly man, she kinda scares me.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Why does she scare you?[/i]

[b]Co-worker:[/b] Sometimes she just stares at me when I talk to her… completely silent… for just like, minutes at a time. I feel like I can sorta see my soul reflected in her eyes, and I don’t like what I see…

[b]Co-worker:[/b] [i]You two don’t get along?[/i]

[b]Co-worker:[/b] Did she say that? I didn’t say that! I’m too lonely to rule anything out… wait, she’s not gonna read this, is she?

notes.title: 5 Days until Launch!
notes.notes:
[i]With [b]Negative Nancy[/b] coming to Steam in 5 days, we decided to interview some of the characters from the game. We wanted to hear their thoughts on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/2afe842afec5a7e42252a175e381406b67e9e67e.png[/img]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Is it true you once arrested Nancy before she was famous?[/i]

[b]Detective:[/b] That’s right.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Can I ask what for?[/i]

[b]Detective:[/b] Who’s asking, huh? You with GAWDDAMN internal affairs?

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]No, we’re doing a fluff piece on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[b]Detective:[/b] Nancy… yeah, I remember Nancy. Sure, the charges didn’t stick… but she’s guilty of something. You’ll see.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]But you couldn’t prove it?[/i]

[b]Detective:[/b] Listen, you GAWDDAMN hack! You been on the force as long as I have, you don’t need crap like ‘evidence’ and ‘due process’... criminals make my teeth ache, and JUSTICE is the only dentist I trust.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]What do you suspect her of?[/i]

[b]Detective:[/b] One day, she’s gonna slip up. She’s gonna snap. And me and JUSTICE are gonna be ready when she does…

[i]With [b]Negative Nancy[/b] coming to Steam in 6 days, we decided to interview some of the characters from the game. We wanted to hear their thoughts on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[b]Prank Pusher:[/b] I dunno, pranks mostly.

notes.title: 7 Days until Launch!
notes.notes:
[i]With [b]Negative Nancy[/b] coming to Steam in 7 days, we decided to interview some of the characters from the game. We wanted to hear their thoughts on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/f95e82f6b2466da43831b0bd317562507396237a.png[/img]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Before her meteoric rise to fame, Nancy visited your health spa. Did you suspect then that she would be this successful?[/i]

[b]Spa Owner:[/b] Of course.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]How did you know?[/i]

[b]Spa Owner:[/b] Nancy is a Scorpio… in the moon-phase we met, fleeting Mercury formed a square with alluring Venus. For a Scorpio like Nancy, these auspices signify a radiant career driven by fiery magnetism.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Nancy was born in early January... wouldn’t that make her a Capricorn?[/i]

[b]Spa Owner:[/b] Yes, of course… in the moon-phase we met, dancing Mercury formed a triangle with voluptuous Venus. For a Capricorn like Nancy, these auspices signify a glittering career elevated by truthful conviction.

---

notes.title: 8 Days until Launch!
notes.notes:
[i]With [b]Negative Nancy[/b] coming to Steam in 8 days, we decided to interview some of the characters from the game. We wanted to hear their thoughts on Nancy’s rise to fame.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/2dc8d3b445b7a1e76456d10b96b2f400f9e7bf49.png[/img]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]As Nancy’s boss, did you ever imagine that she would become this famous?[/i]

[b]Manager:[/b] Well, as a cool boss you always hope that your star quality will rub off on your employees… but there’s no guarantee! You can lead a horse to hustle, but you can’t make it grind.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]Do you feel that working at MegaMart was an important part of Nancy’s journey?[/i]

[b]Manager:[/b] At MegaMart, we try to prepare all our employees for fame… they learn to deal with the public, which is important. We also like to remind them that they’re constantly being watched.

[b]Interviewer:[/b] [i]What message do you have for young people who look up to Nancy?[/i]

[b]Manager:[/b] MegaMart is always hiring, fo’ real! Like, really fo’ real! Our staff turnover is pretty high… not everyone has what it takes to make their dreams come true! Did I already say the horse thing?

---

[i]Negative Nancy will be available on October 14th on PC, Mac and Nintendo Switch. Wishlist today![/i]

notes.title: Negative Nancy WISHLIST and DEMO!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We’re excited to reveal that we’ve been quietly working on an expanded version of Negative Nancy.

The game will be a single release in sitcom format—three new self-contained stories featuring more bizarre situations and an extensive cast of unreasonable characters to deny.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/f116e751242f87f77909169cb16769a41af4b67b.png[/img]

The “pilot” episode of Negative Nancy is now available as a demo. This is an updated version of our 2019 release with new graphics and other tweaks. If you haven’t played it then now’s your chance!
